title: IVG Original Salts Summer Blaze 10ml E-Liquid
description: IVG Original Salts Summer Blaze 10ml E-Liquid captures the essence of a warm-weather refresher in every puff. This expertly crafted blend takes the clean, crisp base of Sicilian-style Lemonade and infuses it with a complex medley of mixed Summer Berries. The result is a vibrant, multi-layered flavour that balances citrus brightness with deep, fruit-forward sweetness. It is a refreshing and characterful vape that avoids being overly sharp or overly sweet. Available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths, this premium nicotine salt formulation ensures rapid delivery and a smooth, comfortable throat sensation to effectively manage nicotine intake. The 50VG/50PG ratio provides an ideal balance of discreet vapour production and clear, intense flavour. IVG Original Salts are designed specifically to perform reliably with low-wattage mouth-to-lung hardware, including refillable pod vape kits and classic starter vape kits. The IVG Original Salts collection is inspired by the brand’s most successful flavour profiles, offering vapers a dependable range of premium fruit, ice, and dessert blends. Beyond the balanced citrus and berry notes of Summer Blaze, vapers can explore other stellar options like the sharp Sour Green Apple or the smooth Vanilla Biscuit. Every e-liquid in this collection is designed to provide a high-quality, authentic experience for mouth-to-lung vapers.
